entries.key: Adjusts the density of the trees. Higher settings mean more trees being rendered on screen, which can reduce performance.
entries.value: 调整树木密度。设置越高，屏幕上渲染的树木越多，可能降低性能。

entries.key: Adjusts the quality and view distance of shadows. Shadow quality can have a performance impact on both CPU and GPU performance.
entries.value: 调整阴影质量与可视距离。阴影质量会同时影响 CPU 与 GPU 性能。

entries.key: Adjusts the quality of the physics simulation. Lower quality levels can improve performance in CPU limited situations. At lower quality levels some craft may become unstable, resulting in vibrations, oscillations, bouncing, exploding, and other forms of chaos.
entries.value: 调整物理模拟质量。在 CPU 受限时，降低质量可以提升性能。质量较低时，部分载具可能变得不稳定，出现抖动、振荡、弹跳、爆散等各种混乱表现。

entries.key: Adjusts the quality of the water. This can impact visual effects as well as some physics effects.
entries.value: 调整水体质量。这会影响视觉效果，也可能影响部分物理效果。

entries.key: Adjusts the visual quality of the clouds, sky, and fog. Higher settings are very GPU heavy. Lowering this setting can have big performance gains for GPU limited situations.
entries.value: 调整云、天空与雾的视觉质量。高设置会显著增加 GPU 负担。在 GPU 受限时，降低此项可以大幅提升性能。

entries.key: Adjusts the visual quality of the terrain's surface. Higher settings are very GPU heavy. Lowering this setting can have big performance gains for GPU limited situations.
entries.value: 调整地形表面的视觉质量。高设置会显著增加 GPU 负担。在 GPU 受限时，降低此项可以大幅提升性能。

entries.key: Aircraft Downloaded
entries.value: 载具下载完成

entries.key: Aircraft download canceled
entries.value: 已取消载具下载

entries.key: Choose image
entries.value: 选择图片

entries.key: Controls how this part reacts to collisions: whether it can disconnect, explode, or neither.
entries.value: 控制此零件在碰撞时的反应：是否可以脱离、爆炸，或两者都不发生。

entries.key: Disables the multiplayer chat window. This will prevent you from seeing chat messages and sending chat messages to other players.
entries.value: 禁用多人聊天窗口。禁用后你将看不到聊天消息，也无法向其他玩家发送消息。

entries.key: Downloaded craft
entries.value: 已下载载具

entries.key: How far this gear must be extended before the connected wheel simulates its suspension. Below this the wheel falls back to a plain collider. Set to 0 to keep the wheel simulating at every extension.
entries.value: 起落架需要伸出到多远，相连的机轮才会开始模拟悬挂。低于此值时，机轮会退化为普通碰撞体。设为 0 可让机轮在任何伸出量下都参与模拟。

entries.key: If false, drag is not calculated for this part.
entries.value: 若为否，则不为该零件计算阻力。

entries.key: If false, this part is hidden in the designer.
entries.value: 若为否，该零件在设计器中会被隐藏。

entries.key: If true, this part is excluded from symmetry operations.
entries.value: 若为是，该零件会被排除在对称操作之外。

entries.key: If true, this part will not collide with other parts on the same craft.
entries.value: 若为是，该零件不会与同一载具上的其他零件发生碰撞。

entries.key: Image
entries.value: 图片

entries.key: Limits the maximum refresh rate of the game to improve battery life and reduce overheating.
entries.value: 限制游戏的最大刷新率，以改善续航并减少过热。

entries.key: Shows outlines around selected parts in the designer.
entries.value: 在设计器中显示所选零件的轮廓。

entries.key: The name must not be longer than {0} characters.
entries.value: 名称长度不得超过 {0} 个字符。

entries.key: The name must not contain rich text tags, control characters, or leading/trailing/repeated whitespace.
entries.value: 名称不能包含富文本标签、控制字符，也不能有首尾或重复的空白字符。

entries.key: The number of quicksave files that the game will utilize when quick-saving designer crafts.
entries.value: 快速保存设计器载具时，游戏会保留的快速保存文件数量。

entries.key: This setting changes the way reflections are handled on the craft surfaces.
entries.value: 此设置会改变载具表面反射的处理方式。

entries.key: Tip: Left click on a part in the part list to show detailed information about it.
entries.value: 提示：左键点击零件列表中的零件，即可查看它的详细信息。

entries.key: Tip: You can hold down control while rotating or panning the view to prevent accidentally dragging a part.
entries.value: 提示：旋转或平移视角时按住 Ctrl，可以避免误拖动零件。

entries.key: When true, the fuselage auto-resizes to match connected parts.
entries.value: 若为是，机身会自动缩放以匹配相连零件。
